digest.component_or_area: plan review gate and ticket write paths
propositions: The plan-review admission guard requires description length to not exceed verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8000), but feedback only arrives at review time, causing repeated late failures.

When a ticket description exceeds the configured cap and the plan-review gate is enabled, a save-time warning must be emitted (via CLI stderr, library logger, or MCP result field) stating the violation and that the claim will reject it until shortened.
The warning is computed after the write succeeds and uses the same gate-enablement probe as the review guard, so it never blocks or alters the ticket write and correctly predicts future rejection.
The save-time warning must read verify.max_ticket_description_chars from the same source as the review guard and completion precheck, preserving single-sourcing of the cap.
